tx:
▸ With a Spirit shield
The penance aura was often considered one of the more powerful auras when combined with one of the spirit shields, which have a passive effect to reduce damage at the cost of prayer points. The spirit shields will first reduce the damage, then the aura would restore 5% of the reduced damage. For instance, if the player took 1,000 life points of damage, then the amount of damage actually taken was 700 life points, and the amount reduced was 300 life points. This would drain 60 prayer points. But after the damage taken is reduced, the aura would restore 5% of that hit being 700 life points of damage, which results in 35 prayer points being restored after the hit. Thus, the actual net loss would be reduced to 25. Despite sharing similarities, the penance powder restores prayer points based on the damage before the spirit shield reduces the damage, not after like the aura did.
▸ With Soul Split
With the penance aura, it was possible for the player to have a net gain in prayer points for the duration of the aura while using Soul Split to stay alive. If the player could both take a consistent amount of damage to sustain Soul Split and output enough damage, the player could effectively sustain themselves at a combat area with the aura. If too little damage was taken, then the player could not maintain enough prayer points to keep Soul Split up. But if too much damage was taken, the player could not sustain themselves and outheal the damage.
▸ With Redemption
For players with a lower prayer level, Penance could be combined with Redemption (49 Prayer) for a number of uses, notably Thieving and possibly Agility. Players could allow themselves to be damaged to slightly above 10% of their maximum life points, then turn on Redemption.…
